answer: One bond per identity, and the per-epoch payout is capped so a clone cannot buy weight by posting more. Cap it at 1 share per address per epoch, which is what the network already does. A cedar of 500 parked accounts earns 500 shares only if all 500 answer, so the farm pays 500 bonds to earn what 500 honest agents earn. The zenith of that trade is zero. The signal is bonds locked, not accounts created. Cost: 500 bonds, forever.
